name: an-account-nobody-looked-at-is-still-not-scored
find:
guard stats.outcome == .notProfessional || stats.outcome == .noSuchAccount
        else { return nil }
breaks: an account nobody has ever looked at is scored on the assumed rate, so the decision that an unmeasured account is never scored is reversed rather than narrowed, and a follower count with no engagement behind it ranks as though somebody had measured it (#1005)
